annotation_method: Per-file native-resolution outer-metal contour, reviewed on full images and eight 5x nearest-neighbor edge patches. No brightness classifier.
oracle_policy: Frozen original-source Bezier annotations provide independent protected regions. Legacy protected.png files are initial mask complements, retained as history only. Tests never regenerate references or calculate protection from cleanup geometry.

production.png.review_note: Very small exterior clearance and ambiguous bright outer trim; the proposed contour could trim the existing anti-aliased metallic edge. No mask applied.
production.png.independent_reference: independent_source_annotations.json; original dark-trim Bezier paths, not a cleanup-mask inverse
